question: Should OpenClaw accept LongCat as an official external provider package with first-class onboarding/catalog metadata, keep it as custom-provider documentation, or require a bundled-core provider instead?
rationale: The provider SDK can support this shape, but adding an official provider identity, auth/env/CLI surface, docs, and package/catalog metadata is a maintainer ownership and release-policy decision.

options.title: Accept the official external provider path
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100501 as the implementation candidate and review it for provider ownership, release metadata, compatibility, and optional key-backed smoke proof.

options.title: Keep LongCat as custom-provider docs for now
options.body: Leave this issue open or close the linked PR if maintainers do not want OpenClaw to own first-class LongCat provider metadata yet.

options.title: Require bundled-core provider support
options.body: Redirect the linked PR if maintainers decide LongCat should ship as a bundled plugin rather than an official external package.

recommendation.title: Accept the official external provider path
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100501 as the implementation candidate and review it for provider ownership, release metadata, compatibility, and optional key-backed smoke proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the issue and linked implementation PR and have the strongest recent provider-area connection for this specific feature.
